Hi Samantha - thanks for the note and the clear asks. Summary answers below and next steps for the questionnaire and SCC selection.

1) Roles: confirmed. Acme Health = Controller; Redwood Inference = Processor. Our standard position is processor for customer data processed by the service. We do not assert controller status for customer data; that aligns with most SaaS deployments.

2) DPA: attached is the draft Marissa shared (Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf). The DPA references SCCs for international transfers where needed. We are happy to negotiate limited DPA edits; for procurement velocity we recommend standard language where possible.

3) SCC selection: for the relationship you described (Controller -> Processor) we recommend using the Controller-to-Processor module of the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (i.e., the module intended for transfers where the data exporter is a controller and the data importer is a processor). I’ve attached an SCC selection matrix (SCC_selection_matrix.xlsx) that maps the modules to common customer scenarios.

4) SOC 2 / HIPAA:
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit (Security & Availability) March 2026. I’ve attached a SOC2-report-summary.pdf (redacted executive summary). We can provide the full report under an NDA if required.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports healthcare customers and can execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). We have a standard BAA clause available and can add it to the DPA or execute a separate BAA as needed.

5) Vendor security questionnaire: I will own the questionnaire response. Please send the vendor questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.docx) back to me and I’ll complete the first pass within 3 business days. For procurement handoffs, Rishi will coordinate the commercial threads (pricing/contract).

6) Next steps / proposed timeline:
- Today: Neha to start questionnaire (please confirm you’ve uploaded it or return it to me).
- 2 business days: confirm any DPA redlines; aim to keep changes minimal for speed.
- 5-10 business days: procurement/legal initial pass at your end.

Primary contacts:
- Security & privacy: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
- Contracts / procurement: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
- Account exec: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

If you’d like, I can also schedule a short 30-minute sync between your procurement and our legal/security to speed sign-off.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
